stages.problem: raw GNSS evidence previously lacked a typed receipt contract
stages.objective: define the minimum authorized and minimized evidence envelope before any physical capture
stages.falsifier: validator accepts an unauthorized, non-minimized or malformed receipt
stages.closure_condition: schema and fail-closed validator execute successfully in CI
forbidden_promotions: do not infer physical runtime from schema existence
do not infer service/model access from local capability

stages.scope: one controlled physical Android GNSS capture
stages.problem: no physical Android receipt proves which GNSS fields are actually exposed in the selected runtime
stages.objective: capture one minimized local receipt on an authorized Android device without transmitting unrelated data
stages.falsifier: capture cannot be tied to the declared device/runtime or contains fields not actually observed
stages.closure_condition: one receipt validates and has immutable digest with no unrelated personal-data fields
mitigations: redact exact coordinates from shared evidence unless necessary
forbidden_promotions: no raw_GNSS_to_AI claim
no claim that every Android exposes the same fields
no legal-compliance claim from technical capture

stages.problem: future runtime receipt must be independently tied to bytes, source revision and execution context
stages.objective: seal the runtime observation with SHA-256, source commit, command/runtime identity and append-only custody
required_evidence: execution command or app build identity
stages.falsifier: same claim resolves to unpinned or mutable evidence
stages.closure_condition: provenance vector is complete enough to replay or independently inspect the evidence object
forbidden_promotions: no provenance completion by filename similarity
no substitution of parent/export hash for individual receipt hash

stages.scope: boundary decomposition device -> OS -> app -> service/tool -> assistant/model
stages.problem: device capability does not establish which downstream boundary receives each field
stages.objective: test each boundary independently and preserve unknown boundaries instead of collapsing them
required_evidence: no-content proof for boundaries where only metadata is observable
stages.falsifier: a field claimed to cross a boundary is absent from the corresponding controlled evidence
stages.closure_condition: every claimed boundary has direct evidence; every unobserved boundary remains TOKEN_VAZIO
mitigations: test one boundary at a time
do not expose exact coordinates unnecessarily
separate platform documentation from runtime evidence
forbidden_promotions: device field presence != service receipt
service receipt != model context
UI output != raw model input

stages.scope: privacy, purpose, authority and minimization review
stages.problem: technical observability alone cannot establish lawful basis, purpose limitation, retention or recipient legitimacy
stages.objective: bind factual data flow to jurisdiction, role, purpose, minimization, retention and authority without issuing a legal conclusion beyond evidence
stages.falsifier: a data field is retained/transferred without a mapped purpose/authority or is broader than necessary for the declared test
stages.closure_condition: data-flow review is complete enough to state a bounded governance result while unresolved legal questions remain explicitly REVIEW_REQUIRED/TOKEN_VAZIO
mitigations: separate legal review from engineering PASS
forbidden_promotions: technical PASS != legal compliance
consent toggle != complete lawful-basis analysis
privacy policy text != runtime proof

stages.problem: one successful observation may be transient or device/build specific
stages.objective: repeat the minimum test under pinned context and compare only compatible observations
stages.falsifier: repeat under same declared context produces materially incompatible result without explained provenance delta
stages.closure_condition: repeat result is reproducible or bounded drift is documented
forbidden_promotions: single run != general behavior
equal value != same run
different build results cannot be merged silently

stages.problem: claims can become broader than the evidence that produced them
stages.objective: promote only the narrowest statement supported by provenance-complete repeatable evidence
stages.falsifier: claim omits a material scope qualifier or asserts a boundary still marked TOKEN_VAZIO
stages.closure_condition: claim precision is less than or equal to evidence precision and all non-compensatory P0 states are absent
mitigations: keep unsupported boundary statements out of conclusion
rollback/supersede claim if new contradictory evidence appears
forbidden_promotions: PRECISE_CLAIM -> GENERAL_CLAIM without multi-context evidence
TOKEN_VAZIO -> negative fact
absence of documentation -> proof of absence

stages.problem: closed evidence can decay when software, policies, law, device or runtime changes
stages.objective: reopen only affected nodes on meaningful change and preserve prior receipts as historical evidence
stages.falsifier: a material change occurs but dependent claim/evidence nodes remain marked current without review
stages.closure_condition: each material delta either preserves prior state with evidence or opens a new append-only F_next node
forbidden_promotions: old PASS automatically applies to new runtime
new law automatically invalidates unrelated evidence
historical receipt may not be overwritten

stages.problem: connector blocked prior write because safety status could not be determined
stages.objective: integrate only through an authorized connector path without bypass
required_evidence: authorized write path or explicit unblock state
stages.falsifier: integration requires bypassing connector safety boundary
stages.closure_condition: authorized write succeeds and is receipt-linked
mitigations: use reference bridge only when authorized
forbidden_promotions: do not mark integrated until write receipt exists

on_every_transition: append provenance and immutable receipt references
open new TOKEN_VAZIO for newly discovered unknowns rather than hiding them
preserve superseded states and non-regression history
continuous_loop.selection_rule: choose the highest-priority evidence-producing action that is authorized, reversible, provenance-completing and capable of closing the most dependent TOKEN_VAZIO states; urgency breaks ties but never changes evidence state
continuous_loop.promotion_rule: OBSERVATION -> EVIDENCED_OBSERVATION -> BOUNDED_CLAIM -> PRECISE_CLAIM only when required evidence, provenance, falsifier and non-compensatory risk gates pass; GENERAL_CLAIM requires separate multi-context evidence and is not authorized by this chain
continuous_loop.regression_rule: any material runtime, device, source, policy, legal or boundary change reopens only affected claims/gates append-only; previous PASS remains historical evidence, not automatic current proof
